clues: This town sits on the flat flood lands between two rivers, in the west of its state. It is one of the most well-planned towns of its land.
Summer heat here can touch 48, a brute of a peak. In deep winter, cold waves off the great range drop the air to near 2.
This town was set up in 1976 from scratch, by plan. It was drawn to pull growth away from the great chief town near it.
This town's short name is not a word at all. It is the first marks of five long words strung as one.
More than half of this town is green land, parks and wild groves. It counts as one of the most green towns of its land.
